column1: # Public reference runtime closure vendored by WP0a (architecture.md §2.2). Written by
# Proof base (R4, user decision 2026-10-20): the CURRENT WORKING TREE of the reference clone
# (check_vendor.py --upstream --upstream-base worktree). upstream_sha256 = sha256 of that clone
# file as it is; vendored_sha256 = that file + patches/ (PATCH_ORDER). The clone carries no
# reference runtime/Niantic copyright lines (removed by the owner); no notice file is created.
# upstream_commit is the clone HEAD the files were taken from, not the proof base.
# role tu-wasm-only: c8/time/now.cc is excluded on native: unreferenced in closure;
# Public tree: upstream_sha256 preserves the pre-publication source proof-base hash;
# vendored_sha256 hashes local bytes after patches and the documented naming/comment pass.
# Repository identity, original author contacts and source notices: ../../../../README.md#external-code.
